server.name: io.github.Mogacode-ma/infomaniak-mcp-agent
server.description: Unofficial Infomaniak MCP — hosting, Node.js, mail, DNS, kDrive, SSL, VPS, domains. 81 tools.

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for api.infomaniak.com. Generate at https://manager.infomaniak.com/v3/api-token
environmentVariables.name: INFOMANIAK_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode for manager.infomaniak.com endpoints. 'auto' (default) reads Chrome cookies on demand. 'manual' uses INFOMANIAK_SASESSION+INFOMANIAK_XSRF_TOKEN. 'disabled' skips manager-private endpoints.
environmentVariables.name: INFOMANIAK_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Manager session cookie (used when INFOMANIAK_AUTH_MODE=manual).
environmentVariables.name: INFOMANIAK_SASESSION

environmentVariables.description: Manager XSRF cookie (used when INFOMANIAK_AUTH_MODE=manual).
environmentVariables.name: INFOMANIAK_XSRF_TOKEN
